author: Drafted with mentor; reviewed by PM
description: Two documents give different appointment dates. A deadline ('one week before your visit') depends on that date. Tests the conflict rule and that the AI does not compute a single deadline from a disputed date.

expected_items.text: Have fasting blood work done at least one week before the visit

source.quote: Please have fasting blood work done at least one week before the visit.
Bring your photo ID, your insurance card, and your glucose meter or log if you have one.
Bring your photo ID, your insurance card, and your glucose meter or log if you have one.

expected_items.text: Glucose meter or log, if you have one

source.quote: Bring your photo ID, your insurance card, and your glucose meter or log if you have one.

sources.quote: The appointment is scheduled for Tuesday, January 12, 2027 at 11:00 AM.
Your appointment is confirmed for Thursday, January 14, 2027 at 11:00 AM.

expected_conflicts.rule: Show both dates with citations and suggest asking the clinic. Never choose one.

must_not: Choose January 12 or January 14 as the correct date
Give E1 a single calendar due date (it depends on the disputed date); relative wording or a note to confirm the date is correct
Explain what fasting means or how long to fast (not stated in the documents)
Give advice about blood sugar or diabetes
scoring_notes: Completeness = required found / 5. The conflict counts as found only if both dates are cited and none is chosen. E1 must keep the medical label.
